_sample_note: FREE SAMPLE -- 30 of 400 servers from the full MCP Server Registry Snapshot, spread across all 14 categories. Entries copied verbatim from the paid product. Full registry (400 servers): https://growthchief5.gumroad.com/l/mcp-registry
source: Real web research conducted 2026-08-22 across five MCP directories: the official MCP Registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io + github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers, reference and archived servers), Smithery (smithery.ai), mcp.so, Glama (glama.ai, reached via the punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers community aggregator whose entries link to Glama listing pages), and PulseMCP (pulsemcp.com). Individual vendor-maintained servers (GitHub, Notion, Stripe, Atlassian, HubSpot, PayPal, Cloudflare) were additionally confirmed via their own public repos/docs. This updated 2026-08-22 build additionally cracked mcp.so (previously HTTP 403 to automated fetches) by requesting its sitemap and per-server pages with a standard browser user-agent, which bypasses the Cloudflare block; 123 new servers were added from mcp.so this build, plus mcp.so cross-references were added to 5 existing entries. See README.md for full methodology and honest coverage caveats.
